title: Moth Traps Premium Pheromone Sticky, Non-Toxic & Odorless Moth Catchers for Wardrobes, Carpets, Clothing & Homes (10 Traps)
bullet_points: 🦋 Targets Common Household Moth Species Designed to attract a wide range of moths frequently found in wardrobes and living spaces. The integrated pheromone lure draws male moths to the sticky surface, helping you detect activity early.

📍 Monitor & Protect Wardrobes, Carpets & Fabrics Ideal for use around wool, cashmere, silk, rugs, and upholstery. Position in wardrobes, closets, drawers, or under furniture to spot early signs of moth presence.

⏳ Long-Lasting Performance Up to 3 Months Each trap features a durable adhesive and slow-release pheromone that remains effective for extended periods, offering continuous monitoring with minimal need for replacement.

🐾 Family & Pet Friendly Operation Pheromone-based and completely odourless in normal use. Free from strong chemicals or mothball fumes, providing a discreet solution for bedrooms and shared living areas.
📦 Easy Fold-and-Place Setup Simply peel away the backing, fold into shape along the creased lines, and place flat in target areas. For best results and safety, keep out of reach of children and pets.
